concept.title: Options
concept.shortdesc: In the Options tab you can configure a variety of settings for the HP SmartTracker application: application language, accounting units, accounting currency, logo to be included in reports, and touch points where authentication will be required.

section.title: Accessing the Scheduling Interface
section.p: To access the scheduling interface for SmartTracker reports, navigate to the Reports section in the HP SmartTracker application. Click on Scheduled Reports to open the scheduling interface.

section.title: Setting a Custom Company Logo
section.p: To set a custom company logo for branded reports, go to the Options tab. Under the Logo section, upload your company's logo file. This logo will be included in all scheduled email reports.
